in_marathi.name: Gopinath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Cowherds
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gopinath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gopinath is a name derived from the Sanskrit words ‘go’ (cow) and ‘pana’ (to protect or to have). This name is associated with Lord Krishna, who is often depicted as the protector and shepherd of the cowherds. The name Gopinath signifies the one who looks after, protects, and cherishes his people, just as a cowherd takes care of his cattle.
